Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionTraverse a massive interconnected world on the sand-swept planet of Protea VI. Unveil the grim mysteries of Protea VI at your own pace as Moadra. Endure challenging combat and evolve Moadra's abilities, solve puzzles, and reveal countless hidden paths and secrets throughout your mission to uncover your lost Neera heritage. -Explore An Otherworldly Wasteland Whether you are trying to endure the desolate surface, ascend the deadly, freezing summits, or scout the research facility infested with malicious alien species, Protea VI has many lost secrets to uncover after your ancestors' extinction 20,000 years ago. Dangers await around every corner. -Tools Of Survival Use Moadra’s agility to your advantage to roll, dodge, leap, wall jump, and sprint at never-before-seen speeds to evade deadly organisms and hazardous elements. Use your swift reflexes, an arsenal of weapons, and special abilities to survive everything from low-level threats to gargantuan monsters that force you to use every tool at your disposal. -Use The Environment To Evolve Activate your scanner bot and use X-ray vision to examine creatures and your surroundings more closely. Reveal hidden paths and secret areas invisible to the naked eye, and map out the places you explored. Blow up unfriendly creatures and organisms to absorb their Protoplasm, lumps of energy-packed biomass. Consume it inside organic chambers to apply metamorphosis, and evolve your abilities and weapons to new levels.Show morePublished byGloomsoftDeveloped byGloomsoftPlay withXBOX Series X|SPCHandheldCapabilities4K Ultra HDSingle playerVariable Refresh Rate60 fps+120 fpsOptimized for Xbox Series X|SXbox achievementsXbox cloud savesXbox Play Anywhere XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads

Help Maxwell explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces. A vibrant sci-fi platform adventure game for the Nintendo Switch™, where you help Maxwell the dog explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces - by jumping, shooting, slicing, shrinking, warping and drilling.Maxwell’s homeworld is nearing collapse. In a last ditch-effort to find help, he hyperjumps where no dog has gone before. Stranded, he finds himself on the edge of a hostile system - if there’s any hope of return and rescue he’ll need every friend (and every weapon) he can find.Forced to confront this celestial expanse head on, Maxwell stays strong - determined to keep his head up and lend a helping hand to everyone he meets on his journey. Like all underdogs, the odds are stacked against him, but you can’t keep a good dog down.Key Features· Explore jam-packed levels with multiple routes· Make 50+ friends & collect their friendship cards· Upgrade your blaster with special abilities· Find hidden areas and take on a variety of boss battles· Local couch co-op multiplayer mode· Bonus prequel content: Chapter ZeroSoftware description provided by the publisher.About this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 337 MBNintendo Switch 2: 337 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeSoftware compatibility and play experience may differ on Nintendo Switch Lite. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionEyes locked on your prey. You kill without remorse. After all… it’s either you or them. Sentience fades. This moment is your release. REWARDING MELEE COMBAT Mortal Sin is built around fast, visceral melee combat where every strike matters. Chain slashes, bashes, and kicks into devastating finishers as limbs fly and blood paints the walls. Combat thrives on momentum: move fast, hit hard, and never give your enemies a chance to breathe. ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY Descend into a surreal, ever-shifting nightmare. Procedurally generated levels, randomised quests, and hundreds of hand-crafted rooms make every run feel fresh. Unlock a growing roster of distinct classes, from the great sword-wielding Berserker to the gun-toting Pirate, each with their own play style and wild synergies. SINFUL VISUALS Dive into a bold, graphic novel-inspired world that’s as stylish as it is deadly. Prefer a different look? Mortal Sin now features multiple visual modes and color palettes. Your nightmare, your way. KEY FEATURES - Brutal, skill-based melee with flashy, satisfying combos - Beautiful comic-book visuals, now fully customisable - Dozens of unique enemies that react to your every move - Over a dozen playable classes, each with their own weapons and abilities - A huge arsenal: great swords, spears, guns, claws, and magic - Hundreds of handcrafted rooms across procedurally generated maps - Secret platforming zones with rare loot and hidden horrors - Randomly generated quests with powerful rewards - Multiple color palettes to match your vibe and mood - Infinite runs and future updates to keep the chaos goingShow morePublished byNikola TodorovicDeveloped byNikola TodorovicPlay withXBOX Series X|SCapabilitiesSingle playerOptimized for Xbox Series X|SXbox achievementsXbox cloud saves XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads
